actions.description: Alters core architecture, principles, or system topology; mandates drafting a full superseding ADR
Updates operational parameters, timeouts, or thresholds while preserving core architectural intent
Errata, broken citations, typographical errors, or non-semantic formatting fixes
Additional explanatory prose or diagrams resolving ambiguity without altering decision boundary
Lineage, authorship, or upstream specification references updated
Marks active artifact indicating replacement is currently drafted; permanently frozen from autonomy
Marks older artifact superseded once replacement is formally accepted; permanently frozen from autonomy

metadata.decision_context: Semantic diff inspection for Stage 16 Governance Change

complexity_profile.rationale: Reused directly from sidpa-template's own shared-complexity-profile.json, which itself was corrected from a real ADPA mistake (approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
